comp.xlsx.prefix: Start of the downloaded file name; only lowercase letters without accents.
comp.count: Count of the candidates in the "Compatible formulas" window; {n} = number.
comp.sc.obs: Number of isotope peaks found in the spectrum; {n}.
comp.terms: Terms of the score of a candidate (0-1): {m} mass, {i} isotopes, {f} fragments.
comp.det.limits: Thresholds of the isotope score: {r} resolution at m/z 200, {p} error in ppm, {s} intensity error in %, {mn} threshold in %, {w} weights.
comp.first: Continuation of comp.count; {n} = how many are shown.
comp.scored: Below "Compatible formulas": the isotope/fragment score was calculated only for the {n} closest masses out of {m} candidates; numbers.
